prompt: Teach me the principles of software testing
judge_reasoning: CONSTRAINT CHECKLIST: (1) Teach the principles of software testing (on-topic, direct), (2) provide an explanatory/educational answer (format flexible), (3) avoid major factual errors. Candidate [1] directly lists widely accepted software testing principles (test early/often, thoroughness, independence, real data, automation, etc.) and is the most aligned and complete for the requested topic. Candidates [2]–[4] largely reframe the prompt toward testing levels, tester responsibilities, and automated tools, respectively, which is adjacent/off-topic relative to “principles,” though they are broadly accurate. Therefore, [1] is the best overall response.
